visualPlan.coreConcept: The construction and customization of a vehicle through modular assembly and color application.
visualPlan.visualMetaphor: A modular 3D car chassis on a clean pedestal that dynamically assembles and changes color properties based on interaction.

scenes.visualAction: The final component (a spoiler or roof rack) descends and locks into the chassis with a mechanical click. The car body panels cycle through vibrant primary colors.
The camera circles the car closely, highlighting the different colored panels (red door, yellow hood, green fender). On 'Wait a second', the camera begins a wide lateral pan.
A second car chassis is revealed. It is currently a translucent wireframe. As the camera approaches, blue body panels fly in from the right and snap onto the frame.
The camera settles between the two cars. Two stylized 3D avatars (Brad and Blippi) appear as simplified, high-quality character models next to the blue car. They wave.

visuals.description: A modular 3D car chassis on a clean pedestal that dynamically assembles and changes color properties based on interaction. - 4 scenes
